content:
General
* Too easy as a puzzle. Please re-create the contribution as a clash of code.

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly by following the example there (e.g. use << >> to format line numbers and keywords in bold, use [[ ]] for variables).

Goal
* Constraints belong to the Constraints section and need not be repeated in the Goal section.

Constraints
* Please avoid overstating the possible range of values. Currently, as [[n]] is never below 0 or exceeds 1000, -10^9 and -10^9 would not be appropriate bounds.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement.

Cases
* The statement mentions how to handle negative integers but there are no cases with such inputs.

* Each test and validator should focus on the same scenario while varying inputs and outputs slightly.

Thanks.
